description: Evaluation benchmark set of natural-language CAD part requests and expected geometric properties for the made-cad skill.

cases.title: Perforated Mounting Plate
cases.prompt: Create a 60x40x6 mm rectangular mounting plate sitting on the XY plane (minimum corner at [0, 0, 0], maximum corner at [60, 40, 6]) with a central 16 mm diameter through-hole at [30, 20] and four 6 mm diameter corner mounting holes inset 8 mm from each edge.

cases.title: Extruded T-Profile Riser Block
cases.prompt: Create a T-shaped riser block extruded 30 mm along Y (centered on X and Y, base at Z = 0) from an XZ cross-section with a 40x8 mm base and a 12 mm wide central upright web reaching Z = 28 mm, with two 6 mm diameter mounting holes through the base flanges at X = -14 and X = +14, Y = 0.

cases.title: Revolved Stepped Flange Adapter
cases.prompt: Create a revolved stepped flange adapter around the Z axis using a 36-slice full revolution: a 40 mm diameter, 6 mm tall base flange from Z = 0 to Z = 6 stepping to a 24 mm diameter, 18 mm tall hub from Z = 6 to Z = 24, with a concentric 12 mm diameter through-bore from Z = 0 to Z = 24.

cases.title: Slotted Clevis Fork Block
cases.prompt: Create a clevis fork block of outer dimensions 36x24x32 mm (centered on X and Y, Z from 0 to 32) with a 12 mm wide U-slot cut into the top 20 mm along the full Y depth (Z from 12 to 32) and an 8 mm diameter cross-pin hole along the X axis centered at Y = 0, Z = 22.

cases.title: Extruded Hexagonal Nut Blank
cases.prompt: Create a hexagonal nut blank extruded from a 6-sided regular polygon of circumradius 14 mm on the XY plane to a height of 10 mm (Z from 0 to 10), with a central 12 mm diameter bore along the Z axis.
